title: React Compose Store Kit Line Host
description: Implement ComposeStoreKitLineHost in @semio-tech/compose-react (logic/index.tsx): openSessionHttp, full provider chain, dispose on unmount. Fix tsconfig paths for @semio-tech/compose-js and @semio-tech/compose-rs-wasm from logic folder. Fix missing ID type import. Ensure tsc and vitest pass.
summary: Added ComposeStoreKitLineHost: opens HTTP session via openSessionHttp, resolves first store and WIP kit id, composes Session→Store→LocalProvider→Wip→TheKit→Kit providers, disposes on unmount, optional fallback and installCreateDto/timeoutMs. Re-exported SessionHttpOpenOptions, openSessionHttp, and ID from @semio-tech/compose-js. Fixed logic tsconfig and Vite paths to ../../js and ../../rs/pkg (logic lives under react/logic). Fixed Nx cwd to logic for tsc/vitest. Extended Vitest with host coverage (mock session).
